instagram:
Template website: aapki template website aapka asli business customer se chhupa rahi hai. Logo dala, colours badle, par customer ko aapka kaam kahin dikhta nahi. 😬

Template mein fixed sections hote hain: slider, about, services, contact. Aapka business in khaanon mein fit ho ya na ho, aapko use fit karna padta hai.

Ek packaging manufacturer bade brands aur chhoti shops, dono ko supply karta hai. Bade brand ko chahiye capacity, certifications aur sample process. Chhoti shop ko chahiye minimum order, rate aur delivery time. Template mein ek hi services page tha, aur dono ki baat adhoori reh gayi.

Custom site mein pages customer ke hisaab se bante hain: bade buyers ke liye ek raasta, chhote buyers ke liye doosra. Structure pehle, design baad mein.

Aapke business ki kaun si baat aapki website par abhi nahi dikhti? Comment mein bataiye 👇
